integrity: All new finite counts, representatives, orbit sizes, stabilizers, and distance profiles were regenerated from the embedded standalone verifier. The literature comparison distinguishes the published optimum-size result from the new complete equality classification.
scientific_limitations: The finite verifier classifies all seven-codeword equality cases using the published length-three IPP1/IPP2 characterization. The upper bound F(3,5)=7 is taken from the published theorem and is not independently re-proved by the verifier.
title: Complete equality classification for five-symbol length-three 2-IPP codes
